loops.name: Playwright CLI orphan process reaper
loops.safetyPolicy: Default mode terminates only Playwright-owned browser processes with PPID 1. Force mode closes every Playwright CLI session and cleans remaining marker-matched daemon and browser processes. Normal Chrome processes are never selected.

loops.name: Manual projects rsync to Mac Studio Desktop
loops.safetyPolicy: Manual one-way MacBook to Studio Desktop sync. The script never passes --delete, so Studio-only files are kept. It fails fast when SSH is unavailable and uses a lock directory to prevent overlap.

loops.name: Spotlight exclusions for CI runner, VM disk and model trees
loops.safetyPolicy: Not a launchd job: editing the root-owned Spotlight Privacy plist needs interactive sudo, so it runs by hand (ssh -t for the prompt). Idempotent and append-only: adds configured paths missing from the exclusion list, never removes one, and restarts mds only when the list changed. Paths absent on disk are skipped.
